notes_for_editor: The Staunton tower has almost no direct record. The list gives a point at 31.28226, -83.46507 with no register number. The two 2014 Commons photos (MJ Taylor Rd. and I-75 Exit 37) are the only tower description found for Cook County, and their file descriptions do not name Staunton. Their geodata (about 31.109, -83.426 and 31.112, -83.428; page metadata, not visible text, so not quoted) sits roughly 20 km south-east of the list point, so they may show a different tower. The story keeps the two apart and says it is unclear. If the editor confirms the link with a source, the 2018 demolition can move into the fate section. Photos are included captioned as unconfirmed; drop them if preferred. No cached register (NHLR, FFLOS) lists a Staunton tower. Vanishing Georgia's Staunton page is about the community, not the tower.
